description: Hope as she looked alive: a slender blue whale gliding just below the surface, deep blue-grey mottled skin, pale ribbed throat, sunlight rays through the water.

Realistic character sheet: front view, full side view, and four expressions (calm, curious, delighted, thoughtful) shown through eyes, head angle and a slightly open mouth. Carries text labels (HOPE, FRONT, SIDE, CALM...), so it must be cropped into text-free views before use as a video reference.

Lightly anime-styled character sheet: simplified mottling, clearer outline, livelier eyes; same views and four expressions. Carries text labels, so it must be cropped into text-free views before use as a video reference.
